title: SEO Blog Post Outline
prompt: Create a comprehensive blog outline for "[TOPIC]" targeting the keyword "[KEYWORD]". Include H2 and H3 headings, key points for each section, and suggested word count. Optimize for search intent.

title: React Component Generator
prompt: You are an expert React developer. Create a [COMPONENT TYPE] component that [FUNCTIONALITY]. Use modern React hooks and best practices. Include TypeScript types and proper error handling.

title: B2B Cold Email Template
prompt: Write a cold outreach email for B2B SaaS sales. Keep it under 100 words. Personalize with [COMPANY NAME] and [PAIN POINT]. Include clear CTA.

title: Instagram Caption Generator
prompt: Generate 10 Instagram captions for a [BRAND TYPE] brand. Make them [TONE]. Include emojis and relevant hashtags for maximum reach.

title: Landing Page Conversion Copy
prompt: Write conversion-focused landing page copy for [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. Include: Hero headline, subheadline, 3 benefit bullets, social proof section, and CTA. Focus on solving [PAIN POINT].

title: Customer Persona Builder
prompt: Create a detailed customer persona for [BUSINESS TYPE]. Include: Demographics, Goals, Challenges, Pain points, Buying behavior, Preferred channels, and Objections. Make it realistic and actionable.

title: YouTube Video Script
prompt: Create a YouTube video script for "[TITLE]" (10-15 minutes). Include: Hook (first 30 seconds), introduction, main content with 3-5 key points, examples, and outro with CTA. Write in conversational tone.

title: Twitter Thread Generator
prompt: Generate a 10-tweet thread about [TOPIC] that educates and entertains. Start with a hook, provide value in each tweet, and end with a call-to-action. Use simple language.

title: Product Description Writer
prompt: Create a compelling product description for [PRODUCT] that highlights [FEATURES] and appeals to [TARGET AUDIENCE]. Use persuasive language and include a call-to-action. Make it SEO-friendly with keywords: [KEYWORDS]

title: Email Newsletter Intro
prompt: Write an engaging newsletter introduction for [TOPIC]. Make it personal, reference current events if relevant, and smoothly transition into main content. Keep under 150 words.
